shortDescription.text: Code quality metric exceeds configured architectural threshold.
Deployment job executes without an upstream test gate in its needs chain.

help.text: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

shortDescription.text: Deployment workflow triggers on push without branch or tag filters.

help.text: Restrict push triggers using explicit 'branches:' or 'tags:' allowlists (for example, branches: [main]).

shortDescription.text: Third-party GitHub Action is not pinned to a 40-character commit SHA.

help.text: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

shortDescription.text: Workflow grants write-all or omits least-privilege permissions.

help.text: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
Remove hardcoded credential and use secret management.
